```python
def expected_layout(types, module, has_pipes):
    ids = [0]
    slots = []
    def walk(tname, path):
        t = types[tname]
        kind = t['kind']
        if kind == 'alias':
            return walk(t['target'], path)
        if kind in ('bool','char','int','enum'):
            n = ids[0]; ids[0] += 1
            width = 1 if kind in ('bool','char') else (4 if kind=='enum' else bytes_for(t['bits']))
            slots.append((f'x{n}', path, width))
            return
        if kind == 'string':
            n = ids[0]; ids[0] += 1
            for i in range(t['maxsize']):
                m = ids[0]; ids[0] += 1
                slots.append((f'x{m}', path+[i], 1))
            return
        if kind == 'array':
            n = ids[0]; ids[0] += 1
            for i in range(t['size']):
                walk(t['element'], path+[i])
            return
        if kind == 'struct':
            n = ids[0]; ids[0] += 1
            for fname, ename in t['fields']:
                walk(ename, path+[fname])
            return
        if kind == 'void':
            return
    for pname, tname in module['params']:
        walk(tname, [pname])
    rname, rtname = module['result']
    if types[rtname]['kind'] != 'void':
        walk(rtname, [rname])
    variables = ids[0]
    flag = None
    if has_pipes:
        flag = f'x{variables}'; variables += 1
    return slots, flag, variables
```
